title: Tent: Fully Test-Time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization
read_scope: abstract, conference PDF first page and method overview
method_overlap: Updates normalization statistics and affine transformations with entropy minimization on unlabeled test batches.
limitation: A low-entropy objective is not direct evidence of correctness; no whole-policy selector in the inspected passages.

title: Continual Test-Time Domain Adaptation
read_scope: official metadata, abstract, first-page introduction and author README
method_overlap: Weight/augmentation averaging and stochastic restoration maintain continual adaptation state.
limitation: Mechanisms already address nonstationary adaptation and forgetting; not a guarantee of safe policy selection.

title: Efficient Test-Time Model Adaptation without Forgetting
read_scope: official metadata, abstract and PDF first-page methodological introduction
method_overlap: Filters reliable/nonredundant samples for entropy updates and regularizes important parameters against forgetting.
limitation: Selective sample updates and compute reduction already exist; selecting entire adaptation methods is a different variable.

title: Towards Stable Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Wild World
read_scope: abstract and conference PDF first-page description
method_overlap: Reliable entropy minimization and sharpness-aware updates target instability under small batches, mixed shifts and imbalance.
limitation: Those deployment challenges are established, not a new gap; specific new policies must beat robust existing updates.

title: NOTE: Robust Continual Test-time Adaptation Against Temporal Correlation
read_scope: official metadata and abstract; author repository README
method_overlap: Instance-aware normalization and prediction-balanced reservoir sampling mitigate temporal correlation.
limitation: An IID-only selector test would ignore a long-established threat.

title: Robust Test-Time Adaptation in Dynamic Scenarios
method_overlap: Robust normalization, balanced/timely memory and teacher-student updates jointly address changing domains and correlated sampling.
limitation: Continual joint-stream realism is already studied; memory, teacher and update frequency must be included in fairness accounting.

title: On Pitfalls of Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: abstract, setting/model-selection discussion, label/temporal shift results and conclusion
method_overlap: TTAB documents hyperparameter dependence, model-property effects and failure under difficult shifts.
limitation: Even labeled oracle tuning has online batch-dependence complications; model-selection assumptions must be explicit.

title: Realistic Evaluation of Test-Time Adaptation: Unsupervised Model Selection
publicationstatus: conference paper; linked 2024 preprint titled Realistic Evaluation of Test-Time Adaptation Algorithms: Unsupervised Hyperparameter Selection
read_scope: published first-page metadata; linked 2024 HTML selection definitions, setup, discussion and conclusions
method_overlap: Evaluates source validation, cross-dataset supervision and unlabeled proxy metrics for candidate selection.
limitation: Most evidence is obtained after executing candidates; comparisons to pre-action routing must charge the different information/computation budget.

title: AETTA: Label-Free Accuracy Estimation for Test-Time Adaptation
read_scope: official abstract/metadata, indexed accuracy-estimation comparisons and supplemental model-recovery details
method_overlap: Uses dropout disagreement to estimate current adapted-model accuracy; demonstrates model recovery from estimated degradation.
limitation: Already covers label-free recovery decisions, but dropout observations and estimator assumptions incur cost; does not establish pre-action benefit for every candidate.

title: Test-Time Adaptation Induces Stronger Accuracy and Agreement-on-the-Line
locations: Extension to selecting best TTA strategy
method_overlap: Uses post-adaptation accuracy/agreement relationships for hyperparameter and TTA-strategy selection without OOD labels.
limitation: Needs source/ID and multiple-model agreement evidence; observed linearity is not arbitrary-shift identifiability.

title: Protected Test-Time Adaptation via Online Entropy Matching: A Betting Approach
read_scope: official metadata, abstract and arXiv method outline
method_overlap: Entropy-distribution shift detection dynamically drives an entropy-matching adaptation process.
limitation: Shift-triggered adaptation and protecting in-distribution behavior already exist; statistical detector guarantees should not be restated as universal classification-safety guarantees.

title: Monitoring Risks in Test-Time Adaptation
publicationstatus: conference paper; inspected arXiv v1 July 2025
method_overlap: Sequential monitoring of the risk of an adapting model using unlabeled loss proxies and source calibration.
limitation: Proxy-informativeness assumption needs labeled data to verify; unsupervised diagnostics for its violation and reducing monitoring delay/cost remain open.

title: When is Test-Time Adaptation Identifiable From Unlabeled Evidence?
method_overlap: SOURCE/KEEP plus modern TTA menu, prior/stream-regime changes, order-aware pre-action evidence, held-out corruption/transfer evaluation, regret and negative-transfer metrics.
limitation: Finite action menu and main source-model family; evidence sufficiency depends on deployment family. Does not evaluate costed active evidence acquisition or claim universally superior evidence.

title: Tempora: Characterising the Time-Contingent Utility of Online Test-Time Adaptation
publicationstatus: conference paper; inspected arXiv v2 dated 31 May 2026
read_scope: Sections 3–5, version metadata and hardware appendix descriptions
method_overlap: Method utility under physical deadlines, latency penalties and amortized compute budgets; ranking changes with hardware and shift.
limitation: Main episodic IID/default-hyperparameter comparisons leave integration with continual/nonstationary realism as future work; latency-aware ranking itself is established.

title: When and Where to Reset Matters for Long-Term Test-Time Adaptation
publicationstatus: conference paper; arXiv v1 submitted 4 March 2026
read_scope: abstract/introduction, method outline and selected Sections 3.3–3.5
method_overlap: Adaptive/selective reset, importance-aware knowledge recovery and domain-discrepancy-based adaptation adjustment.
limitation: Choosing reset timing, scope or update strength is not new; whole-method benefit conditioned on live optimizer/memory state would need a separate precise comparison.
